name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Laser goes with exactly one of Ford, Watt, or $43k.
Either Bell goes with $73k or Tesla goes with Welder.
Either Oscilloscope goes with $73k or Welder goes with Watt.
Between Oscilloscope and $43k, one goes with Bell and the other with Ford.
The engineer with the Welder's budget is higher than both the engineer with the Caliper and the engineer with the Laser.
Exactly one of these is true: Ford goes with Blowtorch; Tesla goes with Caliper; Laser goes with $43k.
Between Edison and $53k, one goes with Blowtorch and the other with Welder.
